description: Independent structural signature for R1.3 Golden format validation. Describes section order, counts, sentinel strings, and structural invariants for four archetypes. Does NOT reconstruct or duplicate prompt bodies.

sections.description: Scene title with derived duration in seconds
@character, @scene, @props reference declarations
Black-and-white line-art storyboard style, aspect ratio, pencil rendering
Annotation color system: red=body movement, blue=camera movement, green=composition, orange=light direction
Shared visual anchors across all panels in the segment
Numbered phase definitions with camera specs per phase
Phase-separated panel descriptions with timing, shot size, focal length, camera motion, and inline color annotations
Final HOLD state and segment handoff/transition
Storyboard-specific prohibitions (e.g., no soft-edge vignettes)
@upload reference images section
Explicit responsibility for every reference image
Numbered phase definitions with camera specs and timeline
Storyboard arrow interpretation guide
Storyboard reference priority over text descriptions
Live-action or target style, resolution, cinematic quality
Shared lighting, stability, and environmental requirements
Complete ordered timeline with phase-separated per-second descriptions
@audio track section
@prohibitions with human-readable routing marker
@transition / end-of-segment handoff

gun_barrel.description: Attention-contraction chain: WS→MS→MCU→CU→ECU. Rico inspects gun barrel under desk lamp.

audience.description: Three internal shots with hard cuts: WS→MCU→ECU. Information-scale progression with audience venue.

prep_area.description: Single continuous fixed-camera shot. Delayed character entry, explicit brief pause. No invented internal cuts.

alley.description: Multi-phase motion path: low-angle→tilt-up→helicopter→car. Locked event/direction/landing nodes with OPTIMIZABLE connection record.

rules: Preserve physical correction phrases (e.g., '不是漩涡', '不是笑')
Preserve color temperatures and distances verbatim
Preserve Unicode characters and punctuation byte-for-byte
Do not summarize, translate, or replace synonyms
Storyboard [SB] node IDs must be an ordered subset of video node IDs
Shared shot IDs, phase IDs, anchors, ticks, boundary types, and handoff IDs must agree between views
